exact: regulation of B-1 B lymphocyte differentiation
related: regulation of B-1 B cell development

definition: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate, or extent of B-1 B cell differentiation. B-1 B cells are a distinct subset of B cells characterized as being CD5 positive, found predominantly in the peritoneum, pleural cavities, and spleen, and enriched for self-reactivity.
label: regulation of B-1 B cell differentiation
